description: Logical input views for Action Plan First report structure; raw/source schema remains unchanged.

field_conventions.Definisi Pakai: Unit post/artikel/komentar yang dianalisis. Dipakai untuk count volume, total news, total mentions, atau unique content.
field_conventions.Catatan Implementasi: Pastikan deduplication rule konsisten per report.

field_conventions.Definisi Pakai: Total interaksi. Bisa mencakup likes, comments, shares, replies, views, atau metrik lain sesuai definisi platform.
field_conventions.Catatan Implementasi: Jika komponen engagement berbeda per platform, simpan definisi di metadata report.
Gunakan casing konsisten; mapping bahasa Indonesia boleh dilakukan di presentation layer.

field_conventions.Definisi Pakai: Platform atau tipe media. Contoh: Instagram, TikTok, X, Online Media, Printed Media, TV, Radio, Blogs.
field_conventions.Catatan Implementasi: Untuk MM/SFIR channel dapat dipetakan menjadi media type.

field_conventions.Definisi Pakai: Brand, campaign, competitor, atau objek analisis.
field_conventions.Catatan Implementasi: Untuk competitive report, Campaign digunakan sebagai brand identifier.
Jika berisi list, parse dulu sebelum agregasi.

field_conventions.Definisi Pakai: Aspek produk/jasa/layanan yang dikaitkan dengan sentiment.
field_conventions.Catatan Implementasi: Dipakai untuk driver positif/negatif dan rekomendasi.

field_conventions.Definisi Pakai: Entitas seperti brand, produk, tokoh, lokasi, organisasi.
field_conventions.Catatan Implementasi: Dipakai untuk evidence dan context enrichment.

field_conventions.Definisi Pakai: Sumber atau figur yang menghasilkan exposure.
field_conventions.Catatan Implementasi: Digunakan untuk ranking influence, profile cards, dan evidence.

field_conventions.Field Umum: Ad Value / PR Value / Potential Reach
field_conventions.Definisi Pakai: Proxy nilai exposure, reach, atau media value.
field_conventions.Catatan Implementasi: Opsional untuk beberapa report; jika tidak tersedia, gunakan N/A.

derived_metric_conventions.Derived Metric: Total Mentions / Total News / Total Content
derived_metric_conventions.Catatan: Gunakan unique(Content) jika tersedia ID konten dan risiko duplikasi tinggi.

derived_metric_conventions.Formula Umum: Engagement / Content atau Engagement / Potential Reach
derived_metric_conventions.Catatan: Pilih formula sesuai report dan tulis definisi.

derived_metric_conventions.Formula Umum: count sentiment category / total content in group
sort descending by Engagement, Ad Value, atau Count Content
derived_metric_conventions.Catatan: Kriteria ranking harus konsisten di seluruh report.

quantitative.purpose: Distribusi volume dan engagement per brand.
quantitative.derived_notes: Basis SOV, SOE, dan performance benchmark.
Basis sentiment landscape dan risk comparison.

quantitative.grain_or_ranking: Topic x Campaign x Sentiment; Top 5
quantitative.derived_notes: Ambil top issues by engagement atau content count.
Basis channel strategy comparison.
Basis content format benchmark.
Basis executive summary dan action rationale.

quantitative.purpose: Distribusi sentimen per channel per brand.
quantitative.derived_notes: Basis risk per channel dan opportunity channel.
Tag bisa dipakai untuk membedakan client, competitor, benchmark, atau category.

qualitative.grain_or_ranking: Campaign x Aspect x Sentiment; Top 3 by engagement
qualitative.derived_notes: Untuk membaca aspek produk/jasa paling dominan per brand.

qualitative.grain_or_ranking: Campaign x Entity; Top 3 by engagement
qualitative.derived_notes: Mendeteksi co-mention dengan kompetitor, produk, lokasi, atau figur.

qualitative.purpose: Highlight konten positif dan negatif per brand.
qualitative.grain_or_ranking: Campaign x Sentiment; Top 3 positive + Top 3 negative
qualitative.derived_notes: Dipakai untuk evidence Executive Summary, risk, dan best practice.

qualitative.grain_or_ranking: Campaign x Author; Top 3 by total engagement
qualitative.derived_notes: Mengidentifikasi source of influence.

qualitative.purpose: Top post social media per brand.
qualitative.grain_or_ranking: Campaign x Content; Top 5 by engagement
qualitative.derived_notes: Basis contoh konten dan benchmark konten kompetitor.

qualitative.grain_or_ranking: Campaign x Topic x Sentiment; Top 5 by engagement
qualitative.derived_notes: Basis issue narrative dan action gap.

quantitative.derived_notes: Sumber big number tiles dan executive summary.

quantitative.purpose: Share of volume dan share of engagement per brand.
quantitative.derived_notes: Bisa hitung SOV jika share belum tersedia.
Basis awareness vs engagement channel classification.
Basis content behavior industry.
Basis thematic/topic trends.
Untuk pie/donut sentiment composition.
Untuk line chart sentiment shift.

quantitative.grain_or_ranking: Topic x Sentiment; Top 10 topic by content
quantitative.derived_notes: Untuk memahami sentiment dominan per topik.

quantitative.grain_or_ranking: Aspect x Sentiment; Top 10 by engagement
quantitative.derived_notes: Basis positive/negative drivers.
Bisa ditambah Count Content jika tersedia untuk ER.

qualitative.derived_notes: Digunakan untuk menjelaskan spike/peak period.
Kutipan harus berasal dari konten asli.
Basis explanation positive/negative drivers.
Gunakan sample content tertinggi untuk memperjelas channel behavior.
Membantu membaca mood industri secara kualitatif.
Untuk tokoh/juru bicara yang mempengaruhi persepsi.
Mendukung risk/opportunity action plan.

quantitative.purpose: Sumber KPI cards: Total Mentions/Buzz, Engagement, Authors.
quantitative.derived_notes: Total Mentions = count Content; Total Authors = unique Author.
Positive/Neutral/Negative share harus total sekitar 100%.
Turunan: total volume, engagement, pos/neu/neg %.

quantitative.purpose: Top Key Topics dan Top 3 positive/neutral/negative topics.
quantitative.grain_or_ranking: Topic x Sentiment; Top 5 by engagement
quantitative.derived_notes: Badge bisa pakai engagement; volume bisa count Content.
Avg Engagement = Engagement / count Content.

qualitative.purpose: Deskripsi 1-liner untuk Top Key Topics dan Thematic Topics.
qualitative.grain_or_ranking: Topic x Sentiment; Top 5 by engagement per sentiment
qualitative.derived_notes: Ambil 1 sample content dengan engagement tertinggi per topic.

qualitative.purpose: Top Positive Content dan Top Negative Content.
qualitative.grain_or_ranking: Sentiment x Content; Top 5 per sentiment by engagement
qualitative.derived_notes: Hanya positive dan negative untuk evidence cards.
Bisa digabung dengan qt_dsm_top_authors_ranked jika field sama.

qualitative.purpose: Bahan narasi summary, thematic narrative, dan key findings.
qualitative.grain_or_ranking: Channel x Topic; Top 2 per channel by engagement
qualitative.derived_notes: Gunakan contoh post top 1 per topic/channel untuk narrative grounding.

quantitative.derived_notes: Minimal field: Content/Buzz count, Engagement, Author.
Minimal: Sentiment, Content Count, Content Share %.
Paling penting untuk perbandingan channel dan action plan.
Jika Media Type kosong, gunakan Channel x Topic sebagai fallback.
Bukti konkret what works.

qualitative.derived_notes: Untuk Brand Health Overview, Content Effectiveness Summary, Prioritas Optimasi.
Membaca hook, format visual, CTA, gaya pesan.
Basis Scale/Fix/Test dan rationale action plan.
Optional evidence untuk format effectiveness.
Optional evidence untuk sentiment driver.
Optional evidence untuk channel effectiveness.

quantitative.purpose: KPI cards: Total Spokesperson, Total Ad Value, Total News, Total Media.
quantitative.derived_notes: Total Spokesperson = unique Spokesperson; Total Media = unique Media Name.
Total News = count/unique Content per Spokesperson; Total Media = unique/count Media Name per Spokesperson.
Plot count content; percentage can be computed.
Map Channel into Online Media vs Printed Media if needed.

qualitative.grain_or_ranking: Spokesperson x Topic; Top 2 topic per Spokesperson
qualitative.derived_notes: Topic ranking dapat memakai Ad Value atau content count, pilih konsisten.

qualitative.purpose: Exposure Analysis quote + analysis per figure.
qualitative.derived_notes: Analysis ditulis oleh analis/model berdasarkan content + media context + sentiment.

quantitative.purpose: KPI Cards: Total News, Total Ad Value, Total Media.
quantitative.derived_notes: Total News = count Content; Total Ad Value = sum Ad Value; Total Media = distinct Media Name.
share_pct = count Content per Channel / total count Content.
Opsional jika visual membutuhkan overall sentiment percent.
Parse topic terlebih dahulu sebelum dihitung.
Turunan: pos_pct, neu_pct, neg_pct per Channel.
Keyword pills = top 3 Topic Extraction per spokesperson.
News = count Content per Media Name; Media Type dapat memakai Channel.

qualitative.purpose: Master table untuk narasi dan evidence.
qualitative.derived_notes: Menjadi sumber universal Top Issues, Sentiment Issues, Sensitive Issues, dan contoh coverage.
Untuk tiap topik: ambil 1 artikel contoh + ringkas dari Content.

qualitative.grain_or_ranking: Sentiment x Topic; 2 issues per sentiment
qualitative.derived_notes: Pilih 2 topic paling representatif by Ad Value per sentiment.
Bahan judul isu, uraian 2-4 kalimat, dan Narasi Media.

quantitative.derived_notes: Mean Total Driver Score across available E/V/O drivers.

quantitative.purpose: Experience, Values, and Offer scorecard by brand.
quantitative.derived_notes: Sentiment and virality indices are category-centred at 100.

quantitative.purpose: Attribute ownership, Best Brand, gap, and whitespace.
quantitative.derived_notes: Attribute Score comes only from row-level tagged content.

quantitative.purpose: Observable perception journey signals by brand.
quantitative.derived_notes: Observable source-role signal, not a commercial-impact claim.

qualitative.purpose: Traceable content evidence for issue-to-attribute findings.
qualitative.derived_notes: Each strategic finding retains a source URL.
Move type uses the locked EVO recommendation vocabulary.

competitive_analysis.output_need: Positioning, key findings, top competitive signal.
competitive_analysis.implementation_notes: Gunakan ringkasan angka dan driver utama, jangan masuk detail tabel.

competitive_analysis.output_need: Defend, Close the Gap, Differentiate, Exploit White Space, Mitigate Risk.
competitive_analysis.implementation_notes: Prioritas harus berbasis gap brand vs competitor, bukan hanya absolute performance.
Hitung SOV dari Count of Content dan SOE dari Engagement.
Gunakan qualitative highlights untuk menjelaskan angka.

competitive_analysis.output_need: Channel mix dan content format comparison.

industry_trend.output_need: Kondisi industri, perubahan utama, driver, risiko, peluang.
industry_trend.implementation_notes: Gunakan data agregat dan event utama.

industry_trend.output_need: Capture Opportunity, Mitigate Risk, Shift Messaging, Channel Focus, Monitor Closely.
industry_trend.implementation_notes: Action tidak brand-centric kecuali brand landscape menunjukkan opportunity.

industry_trend.output_need: Definisi industri, total metrics, data period, sources.
industry_trend.implementation_notes: Jika periode tidak ada di tabel, ambil dari metadata report.
Tidak membuat chart khusus untuk conversation trend jika template melarang.

industry_trend.output_need: SOV/SOE, channel behavior, topic table, sentiment shifts.
industry_trend.implementation_notes: Semua section ini menjadi pembuktian action plan.

daily_social_media_report.output_need: KPI cards, top key topics, summary, top engagement account.
daily_social_media_report.implementation_notes: Summary harus menjawab dominasi percakapan harian dan risiko utama.

daily_social_media_report.output_need: Amplify Strength, Respond Risk, Monitor, Content Opportunity.
daily_social_media_report.implementation_notes: Prioritas harus bisa dieksekusi besok pagi.

daily_social_media_report.output_need: Top positive, negative, neutral topics dan narrative analysis.
Sentiment chart dan sentiment by channel table.
Top author table, top positive/negative content cards.
daily_social_media_report.implementation_notes: Content snippet harus pendek dan tidak dimanipulasi.

brand_content_effectiveness.output_need: KPI, brand health overview, content effectiveness summary, optimization priorities.
brand_content_effectiveness.implementation_notes: KPI dan narasi pendek, bukan detail evidence.

brand_content_effectiveness.output_need: Scale, Fix, Test + action plan table.
brand_content_effectiveness.implementation_notes: Bagian ini dinaikkan setelah Executive Summary.
Gunakan driver positive/negative dari qualitative summary.
Sorot channel paling efisien dan paling berisiko.

brand_content_effectiveness.output_need: Format/topic table dan what works vs needs improvement.
brand_content_effectiveness.implementation_notes: Gunakan pattern untuk membuat rekomendasi replikasi.

spokesperson_intelligence.output_need: Dominant figure, safest figure, risk figure, major issue association.
spokesperson_intelligence.implementation_notes: Ringkas posisi figure dan media exposure.

spokesperson_intelligence.output_need: Amplify, Contain Risk, Clarify Message, Prioritize Media Channel, Monitor Exposure.
spokesperson_intelligence.implementation_notes: Action harus spesifik per figure atau per issue.

spokesperson_intelligence.output_need: KPI tiles dan top spokesperson contribution table.
spokesperson_intelligence.implementation_notes: Urutkan by Ad Value atau Total News sesuai tujuan.

spokesperson_intelligence.output_need: Sentiment by figure dan isu melekat.
spokesperson_intelligence.implementation_notes: Top 2 topic per figure cukup untuk scannability.
Quote harus representative dan tidak terlalu panjang.

mainstream_media_report.implementation_notes: Narasi wajib mencakup posture, driver, early risk, dan urgency.

mainstream_media_report.output_need: Prioritize Issue Response, Strengthen Positive Narrative, Prepare Holding Statement, Activate Spokesperson, Target Media Contributors.
mainstream_media_report.source_input_expression: qt_mm_main_topics_top3; qt_mm_sentiment_matrix_by_channel; qt_mm_spokesperson_overview; qt_mm_media_contributors_table; ql_mm_article_enriched; ql_mm_headlines_summary
mainstream_media_report.implementation_notes: Action plan berorientasi response media dan mitigasi isu.

mainstream_media_report.output_need: Channel distribution, main topics, sentiment by channel.
mainstream_media_report.implementation_notes: Urutkan channel dan topic dari terbesar ke terkecil.

mainstream_media_report.output_need: Issue cards, evidence coverage, sensitive callout.
mainstream_media_report.implementation_notes: Sensitive issues sebaiknya muncul sebelum detail spokesperson jika risk tinggi.

mainstream_media_report.output_need: Profile cards dan media contributor table.
mainstream_media_report.implementation_notes: Keyword pills dari topic extraction yang melekat pada spokesperson.
Tiap sentiment berisi 2 issue + sumber media.

evo_perception_intelligence.output_need: EVOScore, driver posture, primary attribute gap, and decision implication.
evo_perception_intelligence.implementation_notes: Lead with the answer and the decision, not with process.

evo_perception_intelligence.output_need: Scale, Fix, Protect, Build, Test, Monitor, or Avoid moves.
evo_perception_intelligence.implementation_notes: Every move must retain evidence status and smallest next step.

evo_perception_intelligence.output_need: E/V/O share, score, Best Brand, gap, and whitespace.
evo_perception_intelligence.implementation_notes: Best Brand excludes the focus brand.

evo_perception_intelligence.output_need: Comparative Awareness, Engagement, and Perception Impact signals.
evo_perception_intelligence.implementation_notes: Do not claim that awareness or engagement equals perception impact.

evo_perception_intelligence.output_need: Traceable content, classification coverage, metric basis, and limitations.
evo_perception_intelligence.implementation_notes: Keep source URLs and confidence visible.

competitive_analysis.rule: Setiap brand/competitor harus memiliki Campaign/Tag yang jelas.
competitive_analysis.fallback_if_not_met: Tandai brand yang tidak lengkap dan jangan bandingkan sebagai benchmark utama.

competitive_analysis.rule: Count of Content dan Engagement harus tersedia per Campaign.
competitive_analysis.fallback_if_not_met: Jika engagement kosong, SOV tetap bisa dihitung tetapi SOE = N/A.

competitive_analysis.rule: Minimal 1 konten contoh per sentiment penting.
competitive_analysis.fallback_if_not_met: Jika tidak ada, action plan tetap ada tetapi evidence text = N/A.

industry_trend.rule: Count of Content dan Engagement harus ada untuk total summary.
industry_trend.fallback_if_not_met: Jika Potential Reach/Ad Value kosong, tampilkan N/A.

industry_trend.rule: Topic Extraction harus bisa diparsing sebelum agregasi.
industry_trend.fallback_if_not_met: Jika topic list tidak diparsing, top topic bisa bias.

industry_trend.rule: Date harus tersedia untuk sentiment trend.
industry_trend.fallback_if_not_met: Jika Date tidak ada, gunakan overall sentiment saja.

daily_social_media_report.rule: Data harus berada dalam satu daily window atau metadata periode jelas.
daily_social_media_report.fallback_if_not_met: Jika window campur, label report harus disesuaikan.
Jika salah satu kategori tidak ada, isi 0%.

daily_social_media_report.rule: Author dan Engagement harus tersedia untuk top authors.
daily_social_media_report.fallback_if_not_met: Jika Author kosong, tampilkan N/A dan jangan infer manual.

brand_content_effectiveness.rule: Content count dan Engagement harus tersedia.
brand_content_effectiveness.fallback_if_not_met: Jika Avg Engagement tidak ada, hitung dari total engagement / content count.
Jika sentiment kosong, Pos Sentiment = N/A.

brand_content_effectiveness.rule: Content dan Engagement harus tersedia untuk top content.
brand_content_effectiveness.fallback_if_not_met: Jika content tidak bisa ditampilkan, tetap tampilkan metadata dan N/A snippet.

spokesperson_intelligence.rule: Spokesperson harus tersedia untuk seluruh table SFIR.
spokesperson_intelligence.fallback_if_not_met: Jika kosong, row tidak bisa masuk figure ranking.

spokesperson_intelligence.rule: Sentiment dan Content harus tersedia per spokesperson.
spokesperson_intelligence.fallback_if_not_met: Jika sentiment kosong, figure risk = N/A.

spokesperson_intelligence.rule: Content/Title harus tersedia untuk representative statement.
spokesperson_intelligence.fallback_if_not_met: Jika tidak, tampilkan media/name metadata tanpa quote.

mainstream_media_report.rule: Media Name harus tersedia untuk Total Media dan contributor table.
mainstream_media_report.fallback_if_not_met: Jika kosong, Total Media = N/A dan contributor section tidak lengkap.

mainstream_media_report.rule: Topic Extraction harus diparsing sebelum ranking top topics.
mainstream_media_report.fallback_if_not_met: Jika tidak diparsing, gunakan raw topic string dan beri catatan.

mainstream_media_report.rule: Title, Media Name, dan Content harus tersedia untuk issue cards.
mainstream_media_report.fallback_if_not_met: Jika Content kosong, gunakan Title sebagai evidence minimal.

evo_perception_intelligence.rule: Attribute metrics must come from cached row-level classified posts.
Best Brand must exclude the focus brand.
Every evidence card must retain a source URL.
evo_perception_intelligence.fallback_if_not_met: Keep the item out of client-facing evidence.
